svg.title: CausalFill-Bench task icon atlas
svg.desc: Fifteen original configuration icons: word recovery, workflow, grids, vending, adaptive procurement, symbolic robotics, barrier navigation, finite-field and sparse recovery, abstention, proof, diagnosis, controlled perception, rendered robotics and Signal Repair. Capability illustrations, not scores.
svg.text: Original vector artwork · conceptual domains may share configurations · capability illustrations, not evaluation results
